gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.title: Tactical Data Terminal
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.xaero_hint: (Install Xaero's World Map for Cruise / Sweep)
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.move_to.tip: Close the terminal, then left-click a block to send selected units there.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.attack.tip: Close the terminal, then left-click an entity for selected units to attack.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.board.tip: Aim at a vehicle or mortar, then press Board. Uses the live crosshair when you click — not the aim from when the terminal opened.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.board_passenger.tip: Board the vehicle you are looking at, but only into non-driver seats. Units wait beside an empty hull rather than taking the wheel.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.escort.tip: Select units on the ribbon first, then left-click a vehicle for them to stick beside and defend. Right-click cancels.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.set_guard.tip: Select units first, then left-click a block in the world to cache as their GUARD position. Overwrites any previous guard. Right-click cancels.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.reach_guard.tip: Move selected vehicle crews to their cached GUARD position, then hold there. Greyed out when no guard is set.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.patrol.tip: Radius of the patrol area around you in blocks. Crews wander inside it moving to a new spot after a bit, until you dismiss them. Minimum 48.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.search.tip: Radius of the area to sweep, in blocks. A one-time assignment: each vehicle covers its own slice of the area, and the first contact alerts every vehicle on the task onto that target. Minimum 48.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.entrench.tip: Left-click a trench, foxhole, emplacement or sandbag. Selected units crew free weapons first, then hold cells / seat sandbags. Clear with Dismiss.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.dismiss.tip: Stand crews down off Patrol, Search & Destroy, Entrench (trench or sandbag) or a plotted Cruise and return them to their normal behavior. They stay in their vehicles — sandbag seats are cleared here, not via Dismount.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.altitude.tip: Cruise altitude held above the terrain in blocks. Press Takeoff again to retrim an aircraft that is already flying.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.land.tip: Aim at a landing block, then press Land. Uses the live crosshair when you click.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.rappel.tip: Hover and drop weaponless passengers down the ropes.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.line.tip: Vehicles per rank in a Line formation. Once a rank is full the next vehicle starts a new rank behind it.
